avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces elbasvir plasma concentrations, reducing antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; do not use concurrently with elbasvir

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases elbasvir bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all rifampin supplements during elbasvir therapy

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase anticoagulant effects and potentially affect drug metabolism
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E supplementation to ≤400 IU daily; monitor if higher doses needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inducing properties; limited clinical data with elbasvir
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for reduced elbasvir efficacy if taken chronically

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical CYP3A4 inhibition may increase elbasvir levels, but clinical significance unclear
caution_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; patient education recommended

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and BCRP inhibition increases elbasvir plasma concentrations unpredictably
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit and grapefruit juice entirely during treatment; use alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly increase elbasvir absorption; consistent food intake recommended
caution_foods.action: Take elbasvir consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (in excess)
caution_foods.mechanism: High intake may induce CYP metabolism; unlikely significant at normal consumption
caution_foods.action: No dietary restriction needed; maintain normal vegetable consumption

monitoring_notes: Monitor HCV RNA levels and liver function tests throughout therapy, as reduced elbasvir concentrations may result in treatment failure. Counsel patients to avoid CYP3A4 inducers and grapefruit products; recommend consistent food intake patterns to maintain stable drug absorption.
